raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

A request that sends caller `mm_hashes` with an image crashes the scheduler on a cold cache (`index_copy_(): index out of bounds`), and the server stops. On a warm cache it does not crash, but it ignores the caller hash, so an external KV-aware router that sends hashes never gets a prefix match. The cause: the processor (for example Qwen3-VL) builds `padded_input_ids` from its own hash. `TokenizerManager` then applies the caller hash with `set_hash`, which changes each item's pad value but not `padded_input_ids`, and the scheduler reuses the stale ids. This PR rebuilds the ids after `set_hash`, with the same builder that the processors use. Setting the ids to `None` (#40225) also stops the crash, but it moves padding back into the scheduler, which #26097 and #36411 removed on purpose.

## Modifications

- After `TokenizerManager` applies caller hashes, it rebuilds `padded_input_ids` with `MultimodalProcessorOutput.build_padded_input_ids`, if the processor built them. Other processors see no change.
- A new unit test checks that the caller-derived pads reach the processor-built ids.

## Accuracy Tests

Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct on one GPU, tokens-in `/generate` with `image_data`, main at 450837e770 vs this PR merged with it. The caller hash maps to pad 948526808. The processor's own pad for the image is 1023635744.

| Same image, caller `mm_hashes` | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| Cold cache | Scheduler crash: `index_copy_(): index out of bounds` | 200, KV event pad 948526808 |
| Cached before without hashes | 200, cached_tokens 208 (caller hash ignored) | 200, cached_tokens 0, KV event pad 948526808 |
| Same request again | Not run (server down) | 200, cached_tokens 208 |

Requests without `mm_hashes` are unchanged: same caption, 213 prompt tokens and KV event pad 1023635744. Unit: all 11 tests in `test_mm_hashes.py` pass, and the new test fails on main.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. The fix adds one list rebuild per request that has caller hashes and processor-built ids.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`

+                    # The scheduler reuses these ids as-is; set_hash changed the pads.

@@ -6,18 +6,15 @@
      overwrite it via hash_feature().
   3. The derived pad_value is deterministic across requests with identical
      mm_hashes — the property external KV routers depend on.
-
-The wiring step that copies GenerateReqInput.mm_hashes into per-item
-MultimodalDataItem.hash lives in tokenizer_manager.py and is exercised by
-the e2e serve tests; this file pins the unit-level invariants the wiring
-relies on.
+  4. TokenizerManager rebuilds processor-built padded_input_ids after it
+     applies the caller hashes, so the ids carry the caller-derived pads.
 """
 
 import asyncio
 import pickle
 import threading
 import unittest
-from unittest.mock import patch
+from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, Mock, patch
 
 import numpy as np
 import torch
@@ -28,9 +25,12 @@
 from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import (
     Modality,
     MultimodalDataItem,
+    MultimodalProcessorOutput,
     _compute_pad_value,
 )
+from sglang.srt.managers.tokenizer_manager import TokenizerManager
 from sglang.srt.multimodal.processors.hash_executor import MultimodalHashExecutor
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
 from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
 
@@ -95,6 +95,44 @@ def test_set_hash_updates_an_existing_pad_value(self):
         self.assertEqual(item.hash, 0xBBBB)
         self.assertEqual(item.pad_value, _compute_pad_value(0xBBBB))
 
+    def test_caller_hashes_repad_processor_padded_input_ids(self):
+        """Caller mm_hashes must reach the padded ids a processor precomputed;
+        the scheduler reuses them, so a stale pad leaves no slot for the embedding."""
+        override = get_context().override_server_args()
+        override.install()
+        self.addCleanup(override.restore)
+
+        expanded_ids = [1, 2, 9, 9, 9, 4]
+        item = MultimodalDataItem(modality=Modality.IMAGE, offsets=[(2, 4)])
+        item.set_hash(0xAAAA)
+        tm = TokenizerManager.__new__(TokenizerManager)
+        tm.model_config = Mock()
+        tm.model_config.hf_config.architectures = []
+        tm.max_req_input_len = 128
+        tm.mm_processor = Mock(prefer_tokenized_input=True)
+        tm.mm_processor.process_mm_data_async = AsyncMock(
+            return_value=MultimodalProcessorOutput(
+                mm_items=[item],
+                input_ids=expanded_ids,
+                padded_input_ids=MultimodalProcessorOutput.build_padded_input_ids(
+                    expanded_ids, [item]
+                ),
+            )
+        )
+        tm._validate_one_request = Mock()
+        tm._create_tokenized_object = Mock()
+        obj = GenerateReqInput(
+            input_ids=[1, 2, 9, 4], image_data=["image"], mm_hashes=["bbbb"]
+        )
+
+        # The mock processor has no hash executor to await.
+        with envs.SGLANG_MM_PRECOMPUTE_HASH.override(False):
+            asyncio.run(tm._tokenize_one_request(obj))
+
+        mm_inputs = tm._create_tokenized_object.call_args.args[4]
+        pad = _compute_pad_value(0xBBBB)
+        self.assertEqual(mm_inputs.padded_input_ids, [1, 2, pad, pad, pad, 4])
+
 
 class TestMultimodalHashExecutor(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase, CustomTestCase):
     def setUp(self):
